name: Tailscale
short_desc: Attach apps to an existing Tailscale Docker network.
description: Adds a Tailscale section to the settings of every app. When it is on, the main service of the app joins an existing external Docker network, for example the network of a Tailscale or TSDProxy container, next to the networks it already uses. The network has to exist before the app starts.
author: runtipi

global.label: Docker network
global.hint: Name of the existing Docker network the Tailscale container is attached to.
global.pattern_error: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores only

per_app.label: Expose with TSDProxy
per_app.hint: Adds the labels TSDProxy uses to publish the app on your tailnet.

per_app.label: Tailnet hostname
per_app.hint: Name of the app on your tailnet. Also used as its alias on the Docker network.
per_app.pattern_error: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes only

app_settings.title: Tailscale
app_settings.description: Attach the main service of this app to the Tailscale Docker network.
